items.condition: Mixing vertical donor and adiabatic acceptor energies without justification, silently changing dye charge/counterions, attributing all Cy1/Cy2 differences to a single atom substitution, or declaring a kinetic rate from an orbital population invalidates the affected conclusion.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

A selenium atom population or atomic-number scaling argument alone does not measure molecular SOC or establish an ISC rate. Correlated donor/acceptor error cancellation must be examined, not assumed. Molecular energetics alone do not prove solution upconversion efficiency or a film mechanism.
